A '''flying creature''' which strongly resembled known species of [[Insect/Legends|insects]] was seen flying near a river on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], before a [[Unidentified carnivorous tree-like Endorian creature|carnivorous tree]] used its tongue to capture the creature, drag it into its mouth and swallow it whole. The insect made a loud buzzing sound as flied, and its wings were seen rapidly flapping, allowing it to remain airborne before being eaten.<ref name="1-08" />
